Statement I: Traumatic events such as natural disasters, terrorist bombings, and severe vehicle crashes can produce Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD).
Statement II: Symptoms of PTSD include recurrent intrusive flashbacks, emotional numbing, avoidance of trauma reminders, and heightened hyperarousal.

In light of the above statements, choose the most appropriate answer from the options given below:

options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct
options.mistakeAnalysis: Assumed both statements were correct.

options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect
options.mistakeAnalysis: Rejected valid NCERT facts erroneously.

options.text: Statement I is correct but Statement II is incorrect
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Statement I is true while Statement II contains an error.

options.text: Statement I is incorrect but Statement II is correct
options.mistakeAnalysis: Failed to recognize error in Statement I.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
Both statements are correct. Catastrophic traumatic events shatter an individual's sense of security and can lead to PTSD, marked by vivid intrusive flashbacks, nightmares, emotional detachment, and chronic autonomic hypervigilance.
Hence Option B is correct.
Hence, option (C) is correct.

questionText:
Match List I (Endler & Parker Coping Strategy) with List II (Behavioral Illustration):

List I:
(A) Task-oriented strategy
(B) Emotion-oriented strategy
(C) Avoidance-oriented (Distraction)
(D) Avoidance-oriented (Social Diversion)

List II:
(I) Going to watch a movie or playing video games to forget about the examination
(II) Analyzing the exam syllabus, creating a revision schedule, and studying systematically
(III) Calling friends to chat and visit shopping malls to keep one's mind off test worries
(IV) Venting anger, crying, and dwelling on feelings of helplessness and anxiety

Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

options.text: A-IV, B-II, C-I, D-III
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.

options.text: A-II, B-I, C-III, D-IV
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.

options.text: A-II, B-IV, C-I, D-III
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Correctly maps each entity across columns.

options.text: A-III, B-IV, C-II, D-I
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
Task-oriented: studying/planning (A-II); Emotion-oriented: venting/crying (B-IV); Avoidance distraction: movie/games (C-I); Avoidance social: calling friends/shopping (D-III).
Hence Option A is correct.
Hence, option (C) is the correct match.
